title: PR #2401: chore: merge main into dev-1.1
content:
## Summary

Syncs **all changes from `main` into `dev-1.1`** (replacement for the closed #2373, which couldn't be updated because its head was the live `main` branch).

This is a merge of `main` (`89699392`) into `dev-1.1` (`40cffc57`). All of `dev-1.1`'s 1.1 work (`generation`, timeline/ADR-002, `SendLiveMessage`, client-written artifacts, terminal/non-terminal clarification, etc.) is preserved, and all of `main`'s post-branch commits are brought in.

## Conflicts

Only two files conflicted; everything else (including `specification/a2a.proto` and `docs/specification.md`) merged cleanly.

- **`docs/topics/what-is-a2a.md` → kept dev-1.1's version.** dev-1.1 has the current 1.1 rewrite (`/message:send` / `/message:stream` endpoint names, AI-catalog discovery, staged request-lifecycle diagrams); main's version is older (`/sendMessage`, single diagram). Taking main would have regressed 1.1.
- **`docs/llms.txt` → took main's version wholesale.** main deliberately restructured this index into a link list; a line-level 3-way merge produced an incoherent hybrid, so the file is now byte-identical to main.

## Verification

- `specification/a2a.proto`: protolint clean, api-linter `problems: []`, and the 1.1 surface (`SendLiveMessage`, `TaskMessageUpdateEvent`, `artifact_updates`, parent/child additions, etc.) is intact alongside main's gRPC-URL example fix (#1997).
- No conflict markers remain in the tree.
- `docs/llms.txt` matches `main` exactly (any markdownlint findings there are main's pre-existing state, unchanged by this merge).
